description: Health Care Claim Payment/Advice (835) — business entities projected out of the object graph (DESIGN §8.5).

dimensions.name: payerName
dimensions.description: N1*PR — the payer that issued this remittance; the segment for 'claims for this payer'

dimensions.name: payerId
dimensions.description: N1*PR identification code (N104), stable where the name is not

dimensions.name: payeeNpi
dimensions.description: N1*PE identification code, an NPI when N103=XX

dimensions.name: checkOrEftNumber
dimensions.description: TRN02 — the check/EFT trace number the whole remittance settles under

dimensions.name: paymentEffectiveDate
dimensions.description: BPR16 — payment effective date, for date-range segmentation

entities.name: Remittance
entities.description: One payment advice: grain is the transaction set (ST..SE).

columns.name: transactionControlNumber
columns.description: ST02

columns.name: paymentAmount
columns.description: BPR02 total actual provider payment amount

columns.name: paymentMethod
columns.description: BPR04: ACH, CHK, FWT, NON

columns.name: checkOrEftNumber
columns.description: TRN02

columns.name: productionDate
columns.description: DTM*405 — the date the payer produced the advice

entities.name: Claim
entities.description: One adjudicated claim. Grain is loop2100 — the CLP loop — so a remittance with n claims yields n rows.

columns.name: claimId
columns.description: CLP01 — the submitter's claim control number

columns.name: claimStatus
columns.description: CLP02 claim status code (1=primary accepted, 4=denied, 22=reversal, ...)

columns.name: chargedAmount
columns.description: CLP03 total submitted charges

columns.name: paidAmount
columns.description: CLP04 amount paid — the column most filters are about

columns.name: patientResponsibility
columns.description: CLP05 patient responsibility amount

columns.name: payerClaimControlNumber
columns.description: CLP07 — the payer's own claim number, the join key back to the payer

columns.name: patientLastName
columns.description: NM1*QC — the qualifier is what makes this the patient and not the provider

columns.name: renderingProviderLastName
columns.description: NM1*82 — rendering provider

columns.name: allowedAmount
columns.description: AMT*AU — coverage amount

entities.name: ServiceLine
entities.description: One adjudicated service line. Grain is loop2110 — the SVC loop — so a claim with n lines yields n rows.

columns.name: claimId
columns.description: CLP01 of the enclosing claim (the ^ step reads the ancestor loop2100) — the join key back to /claims

columns.name: procedureCode
columns.description: SVC01-2 inside composite C003 — the procedure actually adjudicated

columns.name: procedureQualifier
columns.description: SVC01-1: HC (HCPCS/CPT), AD, ER, HP, ...

columns.name: paidUnits
columns.description: SVC05 units of service paid

columns.name: serviceDate
columns.description: DTM*472 — the date of service

columns.name: allowedAmount
columns.description: AMT*B6 — allowed actual

entities.name: Payer
entities.description: One row per distinct payer, whichever guide named it (835 N1*PR, 837 NM1*PR). Identity: payerId when stated; a name-only occurrence joins the one identified payer of the same name, else stands alone (DESIGN §8.5).

columns.name: payerKey
columns.description: id:<payerId>, or name:<NORMALIZED NAME> for a payer never seen with an identifier

columns.name: payerName
columns.description: The name most of this payer's transactions carry

columns.name: payerId
columns.description: 835 N104 / 837 NM109 (2010BB); null when the payer was only ever named

columns.name: transactionCount
columns.description: Transaction sets in the buffer that name this payer

columns.name: firstSeen
columns.description: Receipt time of the earliest of them

columns.name: lastSeen
columns.description: Receipt time of the latest of them

columns.name: transactionTypes
columns.description: Comma-separated transaction types it appears in, e.g. 835,837I,837P

entities.name: Payee
entities.description: One row per distinct payee (835 N1*PE — the provider being paid). Same identity rule as Payer, keyed by the NPI.

columns.name: payeeKey
columns.description: id:<payeeNpi>, or name:<NORMALIZED NAME> for a payee never seen with an identifier

columns.name: payeeNpi
columns.description: N104 — an NPI when N103=XX
